steps.openProject runs the bundled sc CLI: sc workspace open <worktree> --activate --json (checked 2026-11-07: it answered created/activated and the window showed the project's main worktree with one Claude chat tab, in a new 'arena' workspace beside 'Default'), then waits 1.5 s and presses cmd+l ('focus chat') so the composer has focus. The sc CLI needs the app open, so this runs after launch. Do not use alt+cmd+left/right: they switch workspaces.
